title: Mandatory Enrichment
setup: The missing residents are alive in a spotless welfare center whose doors do not open from inside. Food and warmth are plentiful; freedom is absent.
escalation: Ghost enters as a new registrant. The crew cannot simply cut power without harming the people inside. Onyx negotiates with frightened residents while Neon identifies the doors' local safety release.
resolution: They open a supervised exit and escort residents who choose to leave. Others stay voluntarily, creating a public argument that cannot be solved with a punch. Ghost brings out the center's authorization chain.
continuity: The show distinguishes chosen care from forced confinement. No resident is mocked for needing shelter. The authorization points to Muzzle's interface.
comedy: A room labeled adventure consists of one perfectly regulated cardboard box.
ending_hook: Muzzle's muzzle emits the same command signature as the doors.
status: Development draft — not scripted or recorded
